item.text:
<linkedin_post>A shared robots.txt signal could make it easier for publishers to communicate their preferences about AI training without maintaining a separate rule for every provider.

OpenAI says it will honor the signal, which draws on work by the IETF AI Preferences working group. The company aims to implement it in the coming months and will provide details at that point. Its existing robots.txt crawler controls will remain available.

The signal is a voluntary effort, so website operators will still need to know which providers participate when deciding how to set their rules.</linkedin_post>
